string.text: Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Trigger tuning
Reconfiguration of the trigger assembly with improvement of various parts gives a crisp break with a shorter, smoother trigger take-up, leading to faster follow-up shots.
Threaded barrel
Extended barrel, threaded for mounting a 9x18mm suppressor.
Barrel replacement
Barrel made of modern special reinforced alloy. Can sustain higher chamber pressures, which produce higher muzzle velocity.
Polymer magazine
This product of modern technology allows you to carry more useful things with you.
Polymer parts
Significantly reduces weight by replacing standard metal parts with ones made of heat-resistant polymer.
Rubberized grip
Imported panels improve handling and positively affect accuracy.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Recoil reduction system
Decreases felt recoil, making the shooting more comfortable and accurate.
